description: Single source of truth for the UR5e Jenga work cell. Every leaf is {value, status, source}. status: confirmed (measured or stated by Kaleb / a datasheet), unconfirmed (best guess, must be measured), conflict (sources disagree; the chosen value is the default), placeholder (stand-in geometry), to_buy (item not yet in the lab; value is a design choice). Lengths in metres, masses in kg, angles in degrees unless the key says otherwise. World frame: robot base at the origin, tabletop top surface at z=0, +X away from the robot toward the Jenga tower. No fiducials of any kind (AprilTag, ArUco): calibration is markerless.

tabletop_z_m.source: Design rule: world z=0 is the tabletop top surface (scene.py contract).

bench_height_m.source: Aldrin comments in scene.py say 0.885 m; projects/jenga-rl layout.py says BENCH_TABLE_TOP_Z=0.801 m. Unmeasured: measure floor-to-tabletop in the lab. Only affects the placeholder bench legs; z=0 stays at the tabletop.

bench_top_size_xy_m.source: Placeholder bench in scene.py; the real Vention top size is in the Vention CAD (vention.usd) and not measured.

workstation_xy_m.source: WORKSTATION_XY in settings.py: Vention offset relative to the robot at the origin, from Aldrin's source scene.

base_plate_thickness_m.source: Not measured; robot base placed at z=0 (ROBOT_BASE_Z in settings.py).

initial_joint_deg.source: Presentation pose; not a measured lab home pose.

order.source: Kaleb: likely flange -> Bota -> Quick Changer -> RG2. Configurable: any permutation of bota, quick_changer, rg2 with rg2 last. Verify against the real build.

diameter_m.source: Kaleb's approximate figure (~48 mm); datasheet/caliper not checked.

length_m.source: Kaleb's approximate figure (~32 mm); the real stack height depends on the adapter plates used, not measured.

mass_kg.source: Kaleb's approximate figure (~0.12 kg); weigh it.

sensor_origin_along_axis_m.source: Assumed measurement frame at the mid-height of the body; Bota datasheet shows the true origin.

rate_hz.source: Simulation physics sampling rate, not a claimed real Bota output rate.

wrench_topic.source: Preserves existing twin topic. Bota driver topic not pinned in Max sources; remap/configure after lab topic inventory.

wrench_type.source: Existing twin publisher; wrench_utils.py in RISL_ur.

model.value: OnRobot Quick Changer (robot side + tool side)

standoff_m.source: Aldrin CAD value (robot.py STANDOFF_M); supersedes the URDF's 15.0 mm.

mass_kg.source: Value in a robot.py comment; not weighed.

sim_asset.source: Existing local Husarion linkage asset; authored mass is reported by workcell inspection.

datasheet_mass_kg.source: Kaleb's figure for the official onrobot/onrobot-isaacsim RG2 (~0.78 kg); confirm on the OnRobot datasheet.

husarion_mass_kg.source: Kaleb's figure for the Husarion asset; the smoke test reports the mass actually authored in the USD.

width_command_units_per_mm.source: Max's rg_gripper.py sends the integer string straight to move_gripper in 0.1 mm units (0..1100); his README says millimetres. Code wins.

present.source: Kaleb: small add-on black finger pads.

size_m.source: Sensor carrier concept envelope; matching parametric SCAD is generated from this config.

static_friction.source: Placeholder for black rubber-like pad on wood.

local_centres_m.source: Existing Husarion finger contact-centre convention in robot.py; verify on lab fingers.

fitted.source: Planned demo configuration: two TAL221 cells in printable pads. Not present on the real standard RG2 today.

range_n.source: 500 g nominal cell range. RG2 can exceed this: mechanical overload stops and force limiting required.

topic.source: Proposed name, std_msgs/Float32MultiArray [left_N, right_N]; does not exist on the real robot until the Arduino node is written.

printed_tip_geometry_source.source: Parametric concept with cell pocket; not a manufacturing-qualified fingertip.

model.source: Proposed bridge-output sensor; HX711-compatible. Confirm overload margin before buying.

cell_size_m.source: Packaging envelope only; vendor drawing and hole pattern required before fabrication.

body_size_m.source: Intel D415 datasheet (99 x 20 x 23 mm) as recalled; verify on the datasheet.

color_fov_deg.source: D415 RGB FOV used by Max (camera_model.py) and by the twin's workspace camera.

resolution.source: Placeholder: RGB and aligned depth at 1280x720. Set to the profile the real pipeline uses.

offset_in_tool0_m.source: Default = Max's localizer_bridge.py. Max's camera_model.py has z=-0.010. Aldrin hard-codes a D455 at wrist_3 (0.045,-0.05,0.07) rotZYX(-90,-180,270) (cameras.py), a different camera and mount.

rotation_in_tool0_deg.source: Identity in Max's code: the camera OPTICAL frame (z forward, y down) equals tool0. The USD camera looks along -Z, so workcell.py adds Rx(180) internally.

mount_position.source: Kaleb says it is now mounted UNDER the arm. Neither Max's tool0 offset (y=-38 mm) nor Aldrin's wrist_3 pose is documented as under-arm: the bracket CAD from Max is pending. Re-measure offset and rotation after the move.

bracket_size_m.source: Printed bracket stand-in until Max's CAD arrives.

camera_mass_kg.source: D415 datasheet mass as recalled (72 g).

ros_namespace.source: Proposed: realsense2_camera with camera_namespace and camera_name both set to this. Max's localizer reads the camera through pyrealsense2, not ROS topics.

calibration.value: configurable extrinsics; markerless hand-eye calibration pending
calibration.source: No calibration algorithm or measured extrinsics claimed.

position_m.source: Proposed overhead D415 optical origin; outside 850 mm spherical reach.

look_at_m.source: Placeholder: straight down at the tower base.

color_fov_deg.source: Same D415 as the wrist camera.

calibration.source: No calibration algorithm or measured extrinsics claimed.

type.source: 80/20 1515 gantry is the selected concept; Vention clamp remains a BOM alternative, not implemented.

extrusion_size_m.source: 80/20 1515 series is 1.5 in x 1.5 in = 38.1 mm.

post_xy_m.source: Proposed gantry posts, outside 850 mm radial reach.

removable.source: Mounted on a quick-release base (Thorlabs KB3X3 or SmallRig Arca plate).

quick_release_base.source: Selected camera-only detachable kinematic mount; not a load-bearing gantry base. SmallRig is an alternative.

printed_shelf_size_m.source: Printed camera shelf / tilt arm stand-in.

height_m.source: Design clearance; all overhead rails above 850 mm spherical reach.

block_size_m.source: FMB4 / Aldrin assets (72x24x14 mm). Retail Jenga is often quoted 75x25x15 mm: caliper the actual blocks.

block_mass_kg.source: Kaleb (~15 g); the fmb4 USDs author no mass (density default would give 24 g). Weigh a block.

layers.source: Standard 54-block tower = 18 layers x 3; the phase-1 cell builds a short stack (see tower_layers_built).

tower_layers_built.source: Complete 54-block Jenga tower, Kaleb phase-1 scope.

static_friction.source: jenga-rl block material (0.30 static / 0.25 dynamic); calibration pending.

franka_demo_note.value: sim_tools/jenga.py (Franka demo) uses double-size blocks; left unchanged.

mode.source: Kaleb: physics enables gravity; mirror_real disables gravity on the robot chain only.

joint_states.source: RISL_simulation simulation_node.py params; real UR driver.

trajectory_action.source: RISL_ur scripts (controller_name scaled_joint_trajectory_controller). Sim side: not implemented in phase 1 (joint states only).

value.grammar: open | close | query | <integer width in 0.1 mm, 0..1100>
